label: Distinct existential dependence maps to strict grounding of existence facts
paraphrase: OPEN interpretive premise: for each ordered pair of distinct beings, an existing dependence-for-being edge is represented by a derivable Fine strict partial ground from the existence fact of the source to the existence fact of the dependent. The map does not follow from mere counterfactual co-existence, is not reflexive, and does not identify beings with their existence facts.
